description: Use this when the user asks what they have booked, or about an order whose orderId you do not have. It returns the user's hotel orders, newest first, including those made on the Fortrip website, each as get_order shows it. A next page is the cursor the answer gives.

cursor.description: The cursor the previous page of orders gave for the next one (`nextCursor`).

locale.description: Language for names and text in the response: en or zh.

name: list_orders
title: List orders
